max_pieces_note: the sheet under the flywheel curves the shot out of the robot's back, and as one hull it fills the path between its curve and its chord
motor_source: goBILDA's product pages, read 2026-11-20, at 12 V for the motors

shot.source: 37523's 23 shots in waggle's data/m2_shotfit.json, each refitted with the balls' quadratic drag, k = 0.00073 /in, by archive/shot/dragfit.py, their 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles; the speed then 0.97 of that share, and its and the angle's 10th and 90th drawn 0.75 of the way toward their medians, at the Developer's words of 2026-11-23, so that about 85 % of shots from (35 in, 16 in, -119 deg) rest in red's audience-side cell, archive/game/aimlog.py's SPEED_SCALE and SPREAD; the dips, 191 of 60 ticks/s or more while feeding, in 37523's logs of Meets 2 and 5, as logged; the launch, waggle.shotfit's: from the flywheel's axle, ball_rad_mm from it under the wheel at the launch angle, the ball set where that path is clear_s on, clear of the robot
shot.min_tps_note: a ball touching the flywheel below min_tps ticks/s is not shot and stays as it is; chosen, under half of 37523's target, so a stopped or slowing flywheel throws nothing
shot.spin_note: the rigid model's shots left at 1.08 of rolling spin, but MuJoCo's fluid model turns that spin into a lift of about 0.3 g, where waggle's fits of 37523's flight find a lift of -0.0003 /in to -0.0004 /in, near none; so the ball leaves without spin

contacts_source: a contact a ball makes with each part: its friction and its give, MuJoCo's solref, as mjb.pickup_shoot chose them, the run of archive/feed/wm.py that shot fastest; each chosen, not measured. A key is a body, or mesh: and text a collision mesh's name holds

motor.note: the launcher's 28 ticks a revolution and its shots' speeds are this motor's; the STEP draws a 5203-2402-0019 there

bodies.name: intake_arm
bodies.note: the intake hangs on two 80 mm shafts, clamped by Sonic Hubs and turning in bearings in the 1-hole U-channels on the chassis, goBILDA's assembly guide's steps 29 to 31

joint.stops_note: down at 0 deg, its side plates on the chassis's 43 mm and 24 mm standoffs, from the CAD's surfaces; up at 33 deg at the Developer's words of 2026-11-22, where the CAD's surfaces put its 43 mm standoff on the front edge of the chassis's 1-hole U-channel at 23 deg

motor.note: the motor's 100-tooth gear drives the roller's 20-tooth one

devices.note: Each device by its hardware name in biobuzz, bound to the model's actuator or joint of that name under the robot's prefix. powers: each topic SimRun publishes a power on, -1 to 1, and the actuators it sets. feeder: the topic true while the launcher feeds, and the servo it turns at +1. launcher: the topic of its target speed in encoder ticks a second, its motor's actuator and joint, and the ticks a turn and free speed that make the target a power. wheels: each wheel's joint, front left, front right, back left, back right, as SimRobot orders them.
